verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that all current models accept text and image input with text output, and the vision docs include an honest Limitations section, so developers can send images. The evidence does not document audio input, and it does not show native document or PDF input to the model. The PDF and Office Agent Skills are a separate feature and do not count as model input. missing for 10: documented audio input (or an explicit statement that audio is unsupported), documented native document/PDF input to the Messages API, independent hands-on corroboration of multimodal input.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send images, audio, or documents to the model — or the docs honestly scope the model to text-only input

citations.quote: All current models support text and image input, text output, multilingual capabilities, vision, and tool use.
